CLAIM_A_NEW_WORLD: Hello again, Lea here, former Chief Navigator of the Arvad. I’m excited to help you start colonizing these empty asteroids! First things first, you’ve got to claim your new world - you’ll be the first human to ever set foot on it, afterall! Then it’s time to survey it and discover what resources are there.
BUILD_A_HABITAT: Your crew is going to need a home here. Somewhere to sleep, eat, and live their lives, whenever they aren’t busy working, of course. Let’s get a Habitat up and running for them so they can move down to the ground and out of the cramped quarters of the ship.
CONNECT_THE_COLONY: Next, you need to build a Spaceport. Spaceports allow you to dock your ship on this asteroid and help connect your colony to the many other Adalians in the belt. Remember: we all have a better chance of surviving if we work together, so stay connected!
ESTABLISH_COMMERCE: Marketplaces are essential to our survival. We need to be able to buy, sell, and trade with other Adalians since our resources are so spread out and limited. Now that you have a Habitat and Spaceport, establishing a functioning local economy is the next step.
FOUND_A_COLONY: Well done! This isn’t just a barren lump of lifeless rock anymore - you’ve managed to found a colony in Adalia! Now that you have a Habitat, Spaceport, and Marketplace you are well on your way to having a successful settlement on your own asteroid. Remember: all of these are vital pieces that work together to ensure we survive in this harsh environment.
